sampling: Five comments with the lexicographically smallest string IDs per each of twelve saved discussion threads; 60 comments in total. Selection and annotation did not use teacher labels or model predictions.
limitation: Exploratory assistant annotations, not independent human ground truth. Ambiguous references, irony, product/company boundaries and general AI discussion require human confirmation.
targeting_rule: Use title and immediate parent to resolve the target of the comment. Mark opinions about another product, a different commenter, or the industry generally as irrelevant unless the connection to ChatGPT is unambiguous. Neutral applies to factual or mixed comments about the target. Low confidence records should be reported separately.
